card.name: Descending numbered ranges and grades
card.fires_on: Numbers or units inside a descending or stepped series, such as the lowest grade after 'Grade 4, Grade 3, and Grade', or the age range 'children 4 to 6 years'. It also fires on the gap before the last item in a list of counts.

modes.label: Age ranges
modes.description: The number or 'years' inside a pediatric age band in a dosing list.
modes.example: children 6 to 12 years 0.9 mg to 1.8 mg; children <<4>> to 6 years 0.3

modes.label: Adverse reaction grades
modes.description: The final grade number in a list running from Grade 4 down to Grade 2.

modes.label: Counted lists
modes.description: The space before the last number in a series of counts in news text.
